preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'chk_feedback_suppression_reason'

changeSet.comment: Add INSTANCE_SILENCED: feedback withheld because the instance-wide silent-mode brake was engaged.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE feedback DROP CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_suppression_reason; ALTER TABLE feedback ADD CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_suppression_reason CHECK (suppression_reason IS NULL OR suppression_reason IN ('VOLUME_CAPPED', 'COMPOSER_DEDUPED', 'REACTED_DISPUTED', 'REACTED_NOT_APPLICABLE', 'CONVERSATION_EXPIRED', 'ARTIFACT_GONE', 'ARTIFACT_CLOSED', 'ARTIFACT_MERGED', 'ARTIFACT_DRAFT', 'RECIPIENT_OPTED_OUT', 'EMPTY_AFTER_SANITIZE', 'INSTANCE_SILENCED'));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE feedback DROP CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_suppression_reason; ALTER TABLE feedback ADD CONSTRAINT chk_feedback_suppression_reason CHECK (suppression_reason IS NULL OR suppression_reason IN ('VOLUME_CAPPED', 'COMPOSER_DEDUPED', 'REACTED_DISPUTED', 'REACTED_NOT_APPLICABLE', 'CONVERSATION_EXPIRED', 'ARTIFACT_GONE', 'ARTIFACT_CLOSED', 'ARTIFACT_MERGED', 'ARTIFACT_DRAFT', 'RECIPIENT_OPTED_OUT', 'EMPTY_AFTER_SANITIZE'));
